Hochschule für Musik Würzburg.description: The Würzburg University of Music is a state music university in Bavaria. It grew out of a Collegium musicum academicum founded in 1797, became a university in 1973 and today uses four buildings around the Residenz.

Filmakademie Baden-Württemberg.description: Filmakademie Baden-Württemberg in Ludwigsburg is one of Europe's leading film schools. Around 500 students train in project-based Diplom programs covering directing, screenwriting, cinematography, production, animation, VFX and interactive media; its Animationsinstitut is internationally renowned (multiple Student Academy Awards). Studies start with a four-semester Grundstudium followed by a four-semester Projektstudium.

programs.name: Digital Design
programs.description: Master's program in the computer science faculty for students with a design or computing background, focused on holistically well-designed digital solutions across Gestaltungslehre, Baulehre, Entwurfslehre, and Materialkunde. Admission via aptitude assessment and a minimum grade of 2.5; starts in the winter semester.

programs.name: Fotografie
programs.description: Seven-semester bachelor's program covering technical skills from analog photography to post-photographic and AI-assisted processes, with foundation year followed by specialization from the third semester. Admission via aptitude assessment; starts in the winter semester.

programs.name: Visuelle Kommunikation
programs.description: Successor to the discontinued Kommunikationsdesign program: visual design of content for analog, digital, and interactive media, including corporate design, book/magazine/poster design, campaign development, packaging, illustration, web design, game design, and interaction design. Admission via aptitude assessment; starts in the winter semester.

programs.name: Film - Hybrid & Non-Fiction
programs.description: Three-semester consecutive master's program realizing a film project from conception through production to post-production, aiming at a 'design of the real'; together with the Film & Sound bachelor it holds film school status in the international CILECT association. Admission via aptitude assessment; starts in the summer semester.
specializations: Film (Regie, Kamera, Schnitt, Produktion, Drehbuch, Dramaturgie)

programs.name: Objekt- und Raumdesign
programs.description: Seven-semester practice-oriented project program in three-dimensional storytelling — staging spaces and objects for shops, trade fairs, interiors, film, stage, museums, and public space. Admission via aptitude assessment; starts in the winter semester.

programs.name: Editorial Design
programs.description: Three-semester inter- and crossmedial master's program centered on visual research, authorship, and medium-specific discourse in editorial design, integrating analog and digital print techniques, VR, photography, and film workshops. Admission via aptitude assessment; starts in the summer semester.

Fachhochschule Dortmund.description: Fachhochschule Dortmund (University of Applied Sciences and Arts) is a public university of applied sciences founded in 1971. Its design faculty offers project-based programs in film, sound, photography, visual communication, and object and spatial design; together with its consecutive film master it holds film school status in the international CILECT association.

programs.name: Cultural Studies: Media and Digital Cultures
programs.description: Interdisciplinary cultural studies programme examining digital cultures in their dynamics and consequences. Four core modules in history, philosophy, social organization, and aesthetics are combined with electives on phenomena such as democracy, gender, organization, media technology, and urban infrastructure. Taught in German with some electives in English; 25 study places per cohort.

requirements.label: academic
requirements.text: 60 ECTS in modules relevant to humanities or sociology plus 10 ECTS in scientific theory and scientific methods.

Leuphana Universität Lüneburg.description: Leuphana University of Lüneburg is a public university in Lower Saxony known for its humanities and social sciences profile and its college/graduate-school model. Its cultural studies faculty has a strong focus on media theory, digital cultures, and the arts.

programs.name: Mediendesign und Designtechnik (Kombi-Bachelor)
programs.description: Combined bachelor programme in media design and design technology, taken together with a second subject (typically toward vocational-school teaching). Covers design fundamentals, visual communication, typography, media and design technology, and design history and theory. No numerus clausus, but a passed aptitude assessment (Eignungsfeststellungsverfahren) is required; winter intake with enrolment by 15 October.

languageNotes: German B1 for aptitude test application, DSH-2 for matriculation

programs.name: Mediendesign und Designtechnik (Kombi-Master)
programs.description: Master of Education in media design and design technology combined with a second subject and educational science, preparing for teaching at vocational colleges (Berufskolleg). Open admission (zulassungsfrei); entry in winter or summer semester.

Bergische Universität Wuppertal.description: The University of Wuppertal (Bergische Universität Wuppertal) is a public university in North Rhine-Westphalia with a strong design faculty and combined teacher-training programmes linking design disciplines with vocational education.

programs.name: Mediendesign und Designtechnik (Lehramt an Berufskollegs)
programs.description: Cooperative teacher-training bachelor of FH Münster (Münster School of Design) and the University of Münster, preparing for teaching media design and design technology at vocational colleges. No admission restriction, but a passed design aptitude test (Eignungsprüfung) is required; students enrol at both institutions. Winter intake.

Fachhochschule Münster.description: FH Münster is one of Germany's largest universities of applied sciences. Its Münster School of Design (MSD) on the Leonardo-Campus offers design programmes including cooperative teacher-training tracks with the University of Münster.

programs.name: Theater-, Film- und Medienwissenschaft
programs.description: Open-admission (zulassungsfrei) MA on forms of representation in theater, film, and media, integrating philosophical, art-theoretical, historical, sociological, and cultural-economic perspectives. Requires two modern foreign languages at A2 (or Latin/Greek plus one modern language) and at least four weeks of internship in the theater, film, or media field. Winter intake.

Goethe-Universität Frankfurt am Main.description: Goethe University Frankfurt is one of Germany's largest public research universities. Its Institute for Theater, Film and Media Studies (TFM) is a long-established center for performance and media scholarship.

programs.name: Communication and Media Engineering
programs.description: English-taught engineering MSc (120 ECTS) covering advanced communication technologies, IoT systems, signal processing, wireless networks, AI and machine learning applications, media systems, and IT security, with electives in hardware, software, or management. Winter intake; EU residents apply by 15 July, non-EU residents by 31 March. Non-EU students pay 1,500 EUR tuition per semester (TOEFL iBT 79 / IELTS 6.0 required).

languageNotes: TOEFL iBT 79 or IELTS 6.0

Hochschule Offenburg.description: Offenburg University of Applied Sciences is a public university of applied sciences in Baden-Württemberg known for its English-taught international graduate programmes in engineering and media.

programs.name: Art and Media (Zwei-Fächer-Bachelor)
programs.description: Dual-subject bachelor combining theory and history of art, visual culture, and modern art and media production with aesthetic practice. Open admission (NC-free) but with an entrance examination of theoretical and practical tasks, to be submitted by 1 June of the admission year. Winter intake; taken as major (60 ECTS) or minor (30 ECTS) alongside a second subject.

Carl von Ossietzky Universität Oldenburg.description: The Carl von Ossietzky University of Oldenburg is a public university in Lower Saxony. Its Institute of Art and Visual Culture combines art history, visual culture studies, and artistic media practice, with strong teacher-training tracks.

programs.name: Digital Media and Society
programs.description: English-taught MA (120 ECTS) on digitalization and datafication and their societal impact, combining digital media theory, empirical communication research methods, and practical media work. Specialization areas include digital literacy, media conception, data analysis, and project management in datafied societies. Restricted admission; winter intake.

programs.name: Digitale Medien
programs.description: Joint English-taught Digital Media master of HfK Bremen and Universität Bremen. This listing is the Media Informatics (Medieninformatik) profile, awarded as Master of Science. Apply for the chosen profile at its respective institution; the partner profile has a different award.

details.sourceUrl: Module catalogue Digital Media Master (HfK Bremen / Universität Bremen, 2019-06-21)
languageNotes: English C1. An English-taught university entrance qualification or professionally qualifying degree also satisfies the language-proof requirement. For conditional applications with an unfinished first degree, the language and completion requirements must be fulfilled by two weeks after teaching begins; consult the regulations for document deadlines.

requirements.label: first degree
requirements.text: At least 180 ECTS in digital media, computer science, design, media technology, media studies or a related/comparable programme. Conditional applications are possible with at least 150 ECTS already completed.

requirements.label: selection
requirements.text: An overall assessment of 2.5 or better under the admission regulations, plus a motivation letter and a portfolio of relevant work. The 2.5 threshold refers to the regulated overall assessment, not just the bachelor grade.

applicationRoute.notes: Apply electronically through the portal of the institution awarding your chosen profile: HfK Bremen for Media Design (M.A.), Universität Bremen for Media Informatics (M.Sc.). Include the required work samples and motivation letter. Confirm any foreign-credential checks with that institution.

programs.name: Digitale Medien
programs.description: Program focusing on digital media with emphasis on practical and theoretical knowledge. Joint program of Hochschule für Künste Bremen and Universität Bremen. Offered jointly with Hochschule für Künste Bremen.

Universität Bremen.description: The University of Bremen is a public research university and a center for media and communication research in northern Germany, home to the ZeMKI (Centre for Media, Communication and Information Research).

programs.name: Liberal Arts and Sciences
programs.description: Interdisciplinary liberal-arts bachelor in the Faculty of Humanities, taught in German and English over eight semesters. Admission is restricted (NC); winter intake. No tuition fees beyond the semester contribution.

Universität Hamburg.description: The University of Hamburg is one of Germany's largest universities, with a broad humanities faculty offering interdisciplinary programmes alongside media and cultural studies.

programs.name: Kultur – Sprache – Medien
programs.description: MA (120 ECTS) combining six disciplines: art/visual culture, cultural studies, media studies, literary studies, linguistics, and intercultural business administration, with a focus on the cultures of German-, Scandinavian-, and English-speaking countries around the Baltic, North Sea, and North Atlantic. Open admission (zulassungsfrei); German C1 required.

fees.notes: Keine Studiengebühren

Europa-Universität Flensburg.description: Europa-Universität Flensburg is a public university in Germany's far north with a European and intercultural profile, focusing on education, culture, language, and media studies.

programs.name: Kunstvermittlung und Kulturmanagement
programs.description: MA (120 ECTS) in art mediation and cultural management, combining art history with practice-oriented training for museums, galleries, cultural institutions, and the art market. Admission via aptitude assessment; winter intake.

status.notes: Active Master of Arts program.

Heinrich-Heine-Universität Düsseldorf.description: Heinrich Heine University Düsseldorf is a public university whose art history department runs a well-known practice-oriented master in art mediation and cultural management, benefiting from Düsseldorf's dense museum and gallery landscape.
